narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The angle is eighteen degrees, because ninety divided by five is eighteen.
<bookmark mark='five'/>Five times eighteen degrees is exactly ninety degrees, which is a right angle.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>We need an obtuse angle, so five times the angle must be wider than ninety degrees.

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, pick one of the answers and multiply it by four and then by five.
